feature: Prime contract invoice ERP link and payment attribution

flows.name: Invoice link and payment readback
steps: Verify an Acumatica invoice reference links to AR301000
Verify the three resolved payment records appear
flows.expectedOutcome: The invoice table exposes ERP records and Payments Received reflects the contract-owned Acumatica payments.

claims.description: The three verified Acumatica payments are assigned to the correct contract
An invoice row contains a working Acumatica AR record link
Payments Received displays the resolved rows
Ambiguous multi-contract payment attribution is prevented
